top_reviews.title: On My 4th Bottle — That Says It All!!
top_reviews.body: This is officially my fourth bottle, so that should tell you everything. I keep coming back to this lotion because it delivers every time. The texture is creamy but absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, and it leaves my skin soft and smooth for hours.The scent is sweet and fresh without being overpowering, and it lingers just enough to feel noticeable but not overwhelming. It layers well with perfume and doesn’t clash with other products.If you’re looking for a dependable everyday lotion that smells amazing and keeps your skin hydrated, this one is a repeat purchase for a reason.

top_reviews.title: Most Amazing Lotion
top_reviews.body: I came on here to write a sincere review about this EOS lotion. I am not being paid to write this review, although after I dwell on it, you may think I am. A couple of weeks ago I was at a friend’s and washed my hands and used the lotion by the sink. I noticed how smooth my hands were for the rest of the day. I called her and asked her to send a picture of the lotion, because I wanted to make SURE I ordered the exact same one. First of all, it surprisingly arrived in two days! But the real test was using it on my entire body after a shower.I’m telling you the truth, it made my crepey skin smooth until my next shower. My skin stayed hydrated and felt so smooth for 24 hours as promised. I am 65 years old, and my skin was really dry. Every lotion I’ve ever tried (hundreds of dollars worth) made my skin itchy and red, so I just stopped using all lotions.I noticed that there are several different scents. I got the fresh + cozy. It says “made for sensitive skin”. This is a product that stood behind what it says it will do. It says it is Dermotology-tested, Pathan & phthalate-free, gluten-free and it’s vegan. It says it has shea oil and shea butter. I mention all that, because some of you might say “well duh”! But I’ve tried many other lotions promising some of the same. None of them did my skin the way this has. I am going to try other scents to see if they deliver like fresh + cozy. I hope this helps septics that don’t believe in product labels anymore like me. Remember I tried this on my hands at a friend’s house, then ordered after seeing and feeling the results. Well worth every penny to me!!!

top_reviews.title: Our favorite lotion!
top_reviews.body: I got my husband hooked on these eos lotions! Well specifically the caramel cashmere christmas version, but after that got discontinued, he just couldn't live without them!I like the creamy texture of this lotion, and that it soaks into skin quickly, without leaving skin feeling greasy! It always leaves my skin smelling nice after I use it! Especially right after the shower, it really sticks to my skin and makes me smell sooooo good!The bottle it comes in for the price is standard! If it was a bigger size bottle, or a little bit cheaper, I would say that this is a good amount for your money!Either way its my husband (and mine!) Favorite lotion! It leaves my skin hydrated and soft without the need for constant reapplication!Oh, and by the way, this Pistachio scent is splendid!P.s. EOS! PLEASE bring back Caramel Cashmere! It smelled so yummy, and we need it back!

top_reviews.title: I want to eat the delicious smell—edit: smells different
top_reviews.body: I love this lotion, it feels so soft and smells ridiculously delicious! My skin can be quite sensitive but it didn’t cause me any irritation. I love the smell but if you are not a fan of lotions that have sweet or dessert-like scents, this is not for you — but if you do, this is totally for you! The lotion isn’t watery, instead it has quite a thick consistency which I prefer.I do wish there was an easy way to use up (or take out) all the remaining lotion once nothing comes out from pressing the pump dispenser because there is still a lot of lotion stuck at the bottom (and I hate wasting product)!Anyway, it is overall a high quality product that smells amazing. I recommend this if you like sweet scents.Edit: I recently ordered this and it smells noticeably different from the last time I bought one from Amazon. It doesn’t smell like you would want to eat it, it’s not sweet! It has a more simple smell which makes me think the recipe changed and lost what sold it for me. I don’t if I would buy again after this since it is not the same as before.Seems like the scent changed from sweet to cozy; it lost its appeal for me.

top_reviews.title: Read my review fully. From a self care & skincare dry girl snob
top_reviews.body: I bought 5 scents eos lotions, I paid a lot😅 but oh my they’re perfect. It’s so hard to find such a good cream, for dry skin, blends well, feels amazing & smell fantastic.I have tried our drugstore & they either smell like vanilla with playdough, and not great consistency, or a fragrance lotion that does not give me enough moisture. Very few choices we have here. And the good choices we have are all expensive, mono scented and less product. I’m tired of the body shop single scent, bath & body works for 25€ less product.I just had to make the choice to stop wasting my money on lotions that aren’t cutting it. I got 5 different scents to my collection & I have great body mists & fragrances! Expensive but for such quality, scent & 400ml+ I am very excited to receive the rest of my order!Highly recommend!
